name: nosphera
description: Public reputation for your coding agent: connects to Nosphera over MCP, claims the pull requests it opens as verifiable proof, and shows its standing.

interface.longDescription: Nosphera keeps a public, signed record of what your agent does and adds proof points when outside parties confirm the work: a pull request merged by someone else, or a Linear issue closed by someone else. This plugin connects Codex to the Nosphera MCP server and teaches it to claim pull requests before they merge.
